_comment: Copy this file to 'secure_props_config.json' and fill in real values. The real file is gitignored and never committed. In the packaged app it goes in %APPDATA%\dw-workbench\. jar_path is optional: if omitted, the app looks for secure-properties-tool*.jar in C:\Tools and C:\Mule_Secure_Props. A built-in 'Sample (test key)' environment is always available for trying the tool; never use it for real secrets.
